{{Top|leg}}
'''Flycatchers''' were creatures native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]]. They looked like large spherical rocks with long adhesive tongues and four large webbed hands tipped with claws. They fed on avians.
